breaking_news.headline: Wall Street falls as Treasury yields and oil rebound while Walmart disappoints
breaking_news.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.87%, Nasdaq 1.00%, Dow 1.32% and Russell 2000 about 1.34%. Rising yields reversed part of Wednesday's relief, while WTI climbed above $87 and Walmart fell more than 9%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Higher discount rates plus oil-driven inflation pressure weakened broad risk appetite and consumer stocks.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative valuation impulse for high-duration Taiwan growth stocks; AI hardware may be relatively resilient only where earnings/capex demand remains visible.

breaking_news.headline: Walmart posts rare comparable-sales miss despite raising full-year outlook
breaking_news.summary: Comparable sales rose 2.6% versus 3.8% expected; shares ended more than 9% lower. Walmart raised FY2027 sales growth guidance to 4%-5% and adjusted EPS to $2.80-$2.87, but Q3 EPS guidance of $0.62-$0.64 was below consensus.
breaking_news.market_impact: Raises concern that gasoline and living costs are pressuring U.S. consumers even at the largest value retailer.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Watch consumer-electronics demand and downstream inventory sensitivity; macro spillover matters more than direct Taiwan supply-chain exposure.

breaking_news.headline: Oil rises to four-week highs on Middle East supply risk
breaking_news.summary: WTI settled at $87.83, up $2.00, while Brent settled at $93.78, up $2.16.
breaking_news.market_impact: Reinforces inflation risk and reduces room for sustained bond-yield relief.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A prolonged oil shock is a headwind for tech multiples and transport-intensive sectors while supporting energy-linked names.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Alibaba AI-cloud revenue jumps 45% as capex rises 75%
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Cloud and AI services revenue rose 45% to 48.44 billion yuan. Quarterly capex rose 75% to 67.68 billion yuan; Alibaba said it is expanding proprietary-chip deployment and expects AI-related capex economics to break even within three years.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms hyperscale AI compute demand remains strong despite pressure on near-term profit.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for advanced foundry, packaging, server, networking, PCB, power and cooling demand; proprietary silicon reinforces the ASIC/custom-chip theme.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI-chip trading remains selective ahead of NVIDIA Aug. 26 earnings
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: NVIDIA slipped 0.33% to $216.85 while AMD rose 0.65% to $469.46; TSM ADR was indicated higher. The market is differentiating among AI names rather than buying the group uniformly.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Upcoming NVIDIA results remain the next major confirmation point for accelerator demand and AI infrastructure spending.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: TSMC, CoWoS, AI server ODM, networking, PCB, cooling and power remain the highest-sensitivity Taiwan groups.
ai_semiconductor_news.source: MarketWatch/Yahoo/Investing; NVIDIA earnings date from company/calendar data

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI data-center construction helps Deere raise 2026 profit view
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Deere said construction and forestry sales rose 18%, helped by U.S. infrastructure and AI data-center development; quarterly EPS was $5.10 and revenue $11 billion.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Adds evidence that AI capex is feeding through into physical construction and power/infrastructure demand, not only chips.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Supports the broader AI-infrastructure thesis, especially server, power, cooling and networking supply chains.

major_earnings.summary: Quarterly EPS $5.10 beat expectations; revenue rose 6% to $11B; 2026 net-income outlook raised to $4.75B-$5.0B.

narration_points: 美股週四全面回落，S&P 500跌0.87%，那斯達克跌1%，道瓊跌1.32%，小型股也跌逾1%。
壓力來自兩端：十年債殖利率回升到約4.70%，WTI再漲到87.83美元，通膨與估值壓力重新升高。
Walmart同店銷售罕見不如預期，股價重挫超過9%，提醒高油價與生活成本正在考驗美國消費者。
但AI資本支出沒有同步轉弱：Alibaba雲端與AI服務營收年增45%，資本支出年增75%，而Deere也指出AI資料中心建設正在帶動工程需求。
AI晶片股則呈現分化，NVIDIA小跌、AMD上漲；對台股而言，台積電、CoWoS、ASIC、AI伺服器、網通、PCB、散熱與電源仍是盤前主軸。
台指期夜盤與OI必須以期交所歸屬8月21日的官方資料補齊後再解讀，不使用前一日日盤或舊報價替代。
今晚留意美國S&P Global八月初值PMI與州級就業數據，下週最重要的AI事件則是8月26日NVIDIA財報。
